definitions.gloss: sketch; floor plan; rough diagram; layout drawing
definitions.explanation: A rough drawing or diagram showing the layout of a building, room, or area. Not a precise architectural blueprint, but a freehand sketch capturing the general arrangement.

examples.english: I drew a floor plan of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見取|みと}り{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the floor plan layout on the real estate website.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見取|みと}り{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Before moving, I looked at the floor plan of the new house while thinking about furniture placement.

notes:
A compound of {見取|みと}り (sketching by observation) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing). Often used interchangeably with ⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ in the real estate context, though ⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧ specifically focuses on room layout.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見取|みと}り{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧ (to draw a sketch/floor plan)
- {見取|みと}り{図|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at a floor plan)
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見取|みと}り{図|ず} (sketch of the scene — used in crime investigations)
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見取|みと}り{図|ず} (building floor plan)

Also used figuratively to mean an overview or outline of a situation: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見取|みと}り{図|ず} (an overview of the Japanese economy).
